scripts.deploy: (wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote || echo "No database yet: it is created by the first deploy") && wrangler deploy && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --remote

IMPORTS.description: Background processing of imports and invitations (Queues).

AI.description: Embeddings for similarity between submissions (Workers AI).

SUPERADMIN.description: Comma-separated emails of superadmins: they add the admins who create conferences.

BETTER_AUTH_SECRET.description: A random secret for sign-in sessions, e.g. from `openssl rand -base64 32`.

SCW_SECRET_KEY.description: Scaleway Transactional Email API key, for sending sign-in codes and invitations.

SCW_PROJECT_ID.description: Scaleway project ID of the Transactional Email domain.

EMAIL_FROM.description: Sender address on your verified email domain, e.g. "Conference planner <noreply@example.org>".

BETTER_AUTH_URL.description: The app's address, if you use a custom domain. Leave empty to use the address it is visited on.
